title: rorippa palustris subsp. glabra
intro: Rorippa palustris subsp. glabra, commonly known as Glabrous Watercress, is a subspecies of aquatic plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial plant that grows in wet environments, with edible leaves and stems. The health benefits of Glabrous Watercress include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Glabrous Watercress include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects, and may also contribute to its antimicrobial and antiviral properties.
